about: The minisign public keys that sign urMQTT releases, each for a range of tags only (docs/RELEASE.md section 9, docs/release-key-rotation.md). Paths are relative to this file. Read by the builder page (tools/builder/web/bundle.mjs), the release mirror (scripts/mirror-releases.py --keyring) and scripts/check-release-key.sh.

keys.name: release
keys.note: The project's release key: generated offline by the maintainer, password-protected at rest; its secret is in no repository. Signs every release after v0.4.1.

keys.name: test
keys.note: The project's former TEST key. It signed v0.1.0 to v0.4.1 (those signatures stay valid) and is considered compromised from the day the release key exists: it is accepted for those tags only, never for a newer one.
